title: Overpriced; there are better alternatives
text:
Overpriced; there are better alternatives. Overpriced; there are better alternatives.

I have a number of these, and they are fine, but I think you overpay for what you get.

I now prefer DII basic bar cloths, available here on Amazon for $7.99 for a pack of eight in white. They are very similar to this cloth, but much more reasonably priced.

The Ripple Dishcloth is available in a wide variety of color options designed to compliment any decor style. This set includes four matching dishcloths, each measuring 13 inches square.
